summary: Backend-only testing for Dezi Market iteration 2 (styles[] + external_url + admin user CRUD). Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_dezi_backend.py to cover the new schema and added a dedicated TestAdminUserCRUD class (create/login/duplicate/invalid-role/forbidden/cascade-delete/self-delete/missing). All 43 backend tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Purchase flow is MOCKED (no real payment) — already declared in problem statement.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~890 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, designs, admin, files, comments) for maintainability.

external_url is validated only by length (4-500 chars). It is not enforced as http/https — a value like 'abcd' passes validation. If strict URL format is required (problem statement mentions http/https URL), switch to pydantic HttpUrl or add a regex validator.
DesignCreate.styles caps to 5 (`[:5]`) and falls back to ['modern'] when all are empty; this silent truncation/fallback is not surfaced to the client. Consider documenting or returning 422 instead.
list_designs filter `query['styles'] = style` works because Mongo matches an array containing the value, but this is implicit; an explicit `$in: [style]` would be clearer.

admin_delete_user does not delete the user's `files` records (db.files) or comments left by the user on OTHER designs are deleted, but storage objects in object store are not purged — potential orphaned blobs.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True and allow_origin_regex='.*'; FastAPI/Starlette will refuse to send credentials with wildcard origin in browsers. Tests pass because they use cookies on the same origin, but real cross-origin browser usage may break.
JWT cookies set with secure=False — acceptable for preview but must be True in production.
moderate_design accepts any string for `action`; values other than 'approve' silently become 'rejected'. Validate explicitly (Literal['approve','reject']) and 400 on unknown.
No data-testid concerns since backend-only run.
seed_data_creation: All test artifacts use TEST_ prefix; designs cleaned up via TestCleanup; admin-created users cleaned up by test_admin_delete_cascades. No persistent pollution beyond a small number of TEST_ users from prior failing iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend stack stable on iteration 2. New tests cover styles[] required+non-empty validation, external_url required, filter-by-single-style-matching-array, PATCH on styles/external_url, and full admin user CRUD including cascade delete (designs deleted, login revoked). If iteration 3 adds frontend changes for these fields, focus on (a) DesignCreate form showing multi-select styles + external_url input, (b) Admin Users panel showing Create/Delete buttons, (c) design cards displaying external_url link.
rca of the issue: No outstanding bugs. During test authoring, 5 initial failures all traced to a single test-side issue: expected email kept original capitalization while backend correctly normalizes via .lower().strip() in admin_create_user (server.py:770). Fixed by lowercasing the test email; backend behavior is correct and consistent with /auth/register.
